title.narrative: Government and Civil Society Partnership in Thirty-three Provinces - Indonesia (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Indonesia, which had approximately 193,000 adults living with HIV in 2005, has an overall adult prevalence of about 0.1 percent. However, the epidemic is concentrated among most-at-risk groups and not yet generalized among the population. The program supported by this grant aims to reduce HIV-related illness and death in 33 provinces of Indonesia and to strengthen health and community systems so that performance can be improved. The program targets people who inject drugs and their partners, prisoners, women who sell sex and their clients, men who have sex with men, male-to-female transgender people and people living with HIV and their families. Grant funds will be used for diagnosis and treatment of sexually transmitted infections; methadone maintenance treatment; HIV testing and counseling; opportunistic infection prophylaxis and treatment; antiretroviral therapy; HIV/TB co-infection services; and specific health systems strengthening interventions.

Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
KP PWID-other 1: Number of PWID on OST during the period

Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Percentage of new HIV-positive patients starting IPT during the reporting period
Percentage of people who inject drugs that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of infants born to HIV-positive women receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Percentage of TG that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of MSM that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of people living with HIV that initiated ART with a CD4 count of <200 cells/mm³
KP SW-other 1: Percentage of male workers in the seaport that have received an HCT services during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of individuals receiving Opioid Substitution Therapy who received treatment for at least 6 months
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
KP PWID-other 2: Number of PLHIV receive psycho-social support
Percentage of HIV-positive patients who were screened for TB in HIV care or treatment settings
Percentage of adults and children that initiated ART, with an undetectable viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)

KP-other 1: Percentage of inmate that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
